title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 31
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．３１
overview:
Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 31 is a free Japanese demo disc from Sega that collects trial versions and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demos:
- Guardian Force
- Lupin the 3rd: Pyramid no Kenja

Non-playable previews:
- Wachenroder
- Pro Yakyuu Greatest Nine '98 Summer Action
- Zanma Chou Ougi Valhollian
- Slayers Royal 2
- Capcom Generation Dai-1-shuu: Gekitsuiou no Jidai
- Mahoutsukai ni Naru Houhou

The disc also carries the story of Lupin the 3rd: Pyramid no Kenja as a text file, along with two image files.
